searchText: sorry if this is the wrong channel, but my geth sometimes freezes in InsertBlockWithoutSetHead and then just stops syncing prysm keeps trying to give it the same payload and geth keeps timing out on the NewPayload query yes we have a fix for that in master The problem is that leveldb is doing compactions, which prevents us from accessing the database "shortly" We will be switching from leveldb to pebble soon ™️ awesome, thanks best response I could have hoped for 🙂 do you remember which commit? nvm, found it

excerpts.content: sorry if this is the wrong channel, but my geth sometimes freezes in InsertBlockWithoutSetHead and then just stops syncing

excerpts.author: houseplants5708
excerpts.content: prysm keeps trying to give it the same payload and geth keeps timing out on the NewPayload query

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: yes we have a fix for that in master

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: The problem is that leveldb is doing compactions, which prevents us from accessing the database "shortly"

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: We will be switching from leveldb to pebble soon ™️
